name: Spider-Man (Pavitr Prabhakar)

abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Marked: Regeneration, Immortality, Indestructible ve Death Immunity etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %100 azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek tehlike rakipteki her bonus için %2 kaçış şansı (20 bonusa kadar uygulayabilir, yani %40'a kadar) — bonus immün şampiyon veya kaçış-karşıtı şampiyon şart.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Seshnag
Each Buff on the Opponent reduces the duration of Inexorable and Unstoppable effects on them by [3 - 10]%, to a maximum of 80%.
Personal Energy Vulnerabilities are paused during Pavitr's Special Attacks, and for [2 - 5] seconds after for each level of the Special.
For every 25% of the Opponent's missing Health, Pavitr's Marked Passive gains 100% base potency, even if already active.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Pavitr's attacks deal a burst of [569.04] Energy Damage and do not make contact with Cosmic Opponents.
For each Buff on the Opponent, Pavitr gains a 2% chance to Evade incoming attacks. Pavitr will not Evade while Blocking a Basic Attack.
Being Spider-Man is so easy that Pavitr does not need to benefit from the Mystic Dispersion Mastery.
Pavitr can toggle whether he starts to run after idling by double tapping Block during his Heavy and Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Shape The Battlefield - Mystic Webs
content: At the start of each fight, Pavitr summons three Mystic Webs onto the stage, one at each wall and another in the center.

When Pavitr's Opponent passes through a Mystic Web, it binds to them, placing a Spider-Seal Buff on them. The webs will then reform after 3 seconds, or instantly when Pavitr activates a Special Attack.
If Pavitr knocks his Opponent through a Mystic Web during a Special Attack, he places two additional Spider-Seals on them for each level of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: The Subtle Body - Power Steal
content: When the Opponent gains 1+ Buffs, Pavitr Power Steals 2% of their Max Power or 4% of their current Power, whichever is more.
This Power Steal's base potency is increased by 125% while the Opponent has an Energize or Power Gain Buff, and it does not trigger when the Opponent has 3 Bars of Power.

abilitySections.title: Titan Hunter - Neutralize
content: During the Opponent's Special Attacks, Pavitr inflicts a 35% Neutralize Passive for the duration of the attack and for 2 seconds afterwards. This Neutralize reduces the Ability Accuracy of True Buffs by an additional non-stacking 50%.
When a Buff is prevented by Neutralize or Marked, Pavitr places a Spider-Seal Buff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Seal Away Evil - Spider-Seal Buffs - Max: 20
content: Spider-Seals are indefinite and have no effect on their own. Pavitr gains benefits based on how many are active on his Opponent.
5+ Seals: The Opponent acts more aggressively when not within striking distance, and Pavitr inflicts a second Neutralize during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
10+ Seals: Personal bursts of damage gain 400% increased potency.
15+ Seals: Activating a Special Attack grants a +[1,612.28] Fury Passive for {45} seconds. Reaching 15 Seals for the first time during a Special Attack also grants this Fury. Max stacks: 3.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: The final hit Nullifies 1 Fury Buff and inflicts a Power Steal Passive, stealing 50% of a Bar of Power over 5 seconds. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Waiting to Strike - Special Attacks
content: When Pavitr activates a Special Attack during the Opponent's Dash or immediately upon Dodging, inflict a [687.5] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 18 seconds. Max stacks: 5.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Crab Bow Mount
content: On activation, inflict a 35% Marked Passive for 24 seconds, refreshed when Pavitr performs any Special Attack, unless he is Poisoned.
The final hit places 2 Spider-Seal Buffs on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Agninrutyam
content: During this attack, Pavitr gains an additional +[2,086.48] Attack Rating for each personal Fury active.
The final hit consumes all but {5} Spider-Seals on the Opponent to deal a burst of [11,380.8] Energy Damage. Base potency is increased by 10% for each Buff consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Flight of the Chrysilla Volupe
content: Inflict an 80% Neutralize Debuff for 45 seconds
Gain a Regeneration Passive, healing 15% of missing Health over 15 seconds. Base potency is increased by 5% per Spider-Seal Buff on the Opponent.
Pavitr finishes this attack in the same place he activated it if he is on the Opponent's side of the field.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Seshnag
content: Each Buff on the Opponent reduces the duration of Inexorable and Unstoppable effects on them by [3 - 10]%, to a maximum of 80%.
Personal Energy Vulnerabilities are paused during Pavitr's Special Attacks, and for [2 - 5] seconds after for each level of the Special.
For every 25% of the Opponent's missing Health, Pavitr's Marked Passive gains 100% base potency, even if already active.
